description_en: Detects five facial attributes including gender, age, expression, glasses, and hat, and returns 1024-dimensional deep learning features of the face
description_zh: 检测人脸的性别、年龄、表情、眼镜、帽子五种属性，返回人脸的1024维深度学习特征
name: RecognizeFace

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an OSS link in the China (Shanghai) region. For local files or OSS links in other regions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.

The recommended new calling method is to pass only the image. When only ImageURL is passed, all API data is returned. The new version supports returning data for up to 10 faces.

For backward compatibility with the legacy API, the logic for Boolean input parameters and MaxFaceNumber is supported. When any supported Boolean input parameter or MaxFaceNumber is passed to control the returned data, only data for Boolean parameters set to true is returned. This calling method does not return data outside the scope of Boolean parameters (Landmarks, LandmarkCount, PoseList, Pupils)
parameters.help_zh:
图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。

推荐新版本调用方式为只输入图片，当只传入ImageURL的时候所有接口数据都会返回，新版本支持返回最多10张人脸的数据。

兼容老版本接口对布尔值入参和MaxFaceNumber的支持逻辑，当传入任意一个支持的布尔值入参或MaxFaceNumber以控制返回的数据时，只会返回设置了布尔值入参且为true的数据，这种调用方式不返回布尔值入参支持范围外的数据（Landmarks，LandmarkCount，PoseList，Pupils）

items.description_en: The age of the face in the image. Value range: 0 to 100. If multiple faces are detected, the ages of all faces are returned sequentially
items.description_zh: 图片中人脸年龄，取值范围0~100。如有多个人脸，依次返回多个人脸的年龄

items.description_en: The beauty score. A higher score indicates higher attractiveness. Value range: (0, 100]
items.description_zh: 颜值分数，分值越高颜值越高，取值范围(0-100]

DenseFeatureLength.description_en: The dimension of the features returned by face recognition. Currently fixed at 1024
DenseFeatureLength.description_zh: 人脸识别返回的特征维度，目前固定为1024

items.description_en:
The features returned by face recognition. If multiple faces are detected, the results are returned sequentially.

Due to a version upgrade, this field is deprecated and the returned data has no practical meaning
items.description_zh:
人脸识别返回的特征。如有多个人脸，则依次返回。

由于版本升级，该字段废弃，返回数据无实际意义

items.description_en:
The face expression recognition result. Valid values:

0: Neutral

1: Smile
items.description_zh:
人脸识别的表情结果。包括：

0：中性

1：微笑

items.description_en: The face detection probability. Value range: 0 to 1. If multiple faces are detected, the results are returned sequentially. For example, if two faces are detected, the result is `[face_prob1, face_prob2]`
items.description_zh: 返回人脸检测的概率，取值范围0~1。如有多个人脸，则依次返回。例如有两个人脸则返回`[face_prob1, face_prob2]`

items.description_en:
The face bounding rectangles in the format `[left, top, width, height]`. If multiple faces are detected, the results are returned sequentially. For example, if two faces are detected, the result is `[left1, top1, width1, height1, left2, top2, width2, height2]`.
left-top: The position of the upper-left corner of the bounding box relative to the upper-left corner of the image as the origin (x, y). The value indicates that the first point of the box is x pixels from the left edge and y pixels from the top edge of the image.
width-height: The width and height of the bounding box.
The area of the bounding box is width × height. The lower-right corner coordinate of the bounding box is (left+width, top+height)
items.description_zh:
返回人脸矩形框，分别是`[left, top, width, height]`。如有多个人脸，则依次顺延，返回矩形框。例如有两个人脸则返回`[left1, top1, width1, height1, left2, top2, width2, height2]`。
left-top: 表示以图片左上角为坐标原点，目标框所对应的左上角点位置（x,y），表示框的第一个点距离图片左边界x像素，距离上边界y个像素。
width-height：表示目标框的宽和高。
目标框面积为width*height，目标框右下角坐标为（left+width,top+height）

items.description_en:
The detected face gender. If multiple faces are detected, the results are returned sequentially.

0: Female

1: Male
items.description_zh:
识别到的人脸性别。如有多个人脸，则依次返回。

0：女性

1：男性

Indicates whether the face is wearing glasses.

0: No glasses

2: Wearing sunglasses

items.description_en:

items.description_zh:
人脸是否佩戴帽子。

LandmarkCount.description_en: The number of face landmarks. Currently fixed at 105 points: 24 for eyebrows, 32 for eyes, 6 for nose, 34 for mouth, and 9 for face contour
LandmarkCount.description_zh: 人脸检测的特征点数目，目前固定为105点。依次为：眉毛24点，眼睛32点，鼻子6点，嘴巴34点，外轮廓9点

items.description_en: The face landmark localization results. Each face returns a set of landmark positions in the format `(x0, y0, x1, y1, ...)`. If multiple faces are detected, the results are returned sequentially as floating-point numbers
items.description_zh: 人脸的特征点定位结果，每个人脸返回一组特征点位置，表示方式为`（x0, y0, x1, y1, ……）`。如有多个人脸，则依次返回，返回定位浮点数

items.description_en:
Indicates whether the face is wearing a mask.

0: Not wearing a mask
1: Wearing a mask
2: Not wearing a mask correctly
items.description_zh:
人脸是否佩戴口罩。

0：未佩戴口罩
1：佩戴口罩
2：未正确佩戴口罩

items.description_en:
The face pose in the format `[yaw, pitch, roll]`. If multiple faces are detected, the results are returned sequentially.

yaw: The left-right angle. Value range: -90 to 90.

pitch: The up-down angle. Value range: -90 to 90.

roll: The in-plane rotation angle. Value range: -180 to 180
items.description_zh:
返回人脸姿态，格式为`[yaw, pitch, roll]`。如有多个人脸，则依次返回。

yaw为左右角度，取值范围-90~90。

pitch为上下角度，取值范围-90~90。

roll为平面旋转角度，取值范围-180~180

items.description_en: The center coordinates and radius of the left and right pupils. Each face has 6 floating-point numbers in the order `[left_iris_cenpt.x, left_iris_cenpt.y, left_iris_radius, right_iris_cenpt.x, right_iris_cenpt.y, right_iris_radis]`
items.description_zh: 左右两个瞳孔的中心点坐标和半径，每个人脸6个浮点数，顺序为`[left_iris_cenpt.x, left_iris_cenpt.y, left_iris_radius, right_iris_cenpt.x, right_iris_cenpt.y, right_iris_radis]`

Qualities.description_en: The face quality information. A higher score indicates better suitability for recognition
Qualities.description_zh: 人脸质量情况，分数越高表示越有利于识别

items.description_en: The impact score of face blur on recognition. A higher score indicates better suitability for recognition. Value range: (0, 100]. If multiple faces are detected, the results are returned sequentially. For recognition, the recommended settings require a threshold of 85 or higher (you can determine whether to set a threshold and the threshold value based on your common scenarios). A score above 85 indicates a lower probability of image blur, while a score below 85 indicates a higher probability of image blur
items.description_zh: 人脸模糊度对识别的影响分数，分数越高越有利于识别，取值范围(0,100]。如有多个人脸，则依次顺延。在识别时，推荐设置阈值大于等于85（您可以按实际应用场景判断设置阈值与否及相应阈值大小），大于85代表图片模糊的概率越低，小于85代表图片模糊的概率越高

items.description_en: The score indicating whether the target is a face and its impact on recognition. A higher score indicates better suitability for recognition. Value range: (0, 100]. If multiple faces are detected, the results are returned sequentially. For recognition, the recommended settings require a threshold of 85 or higher (you can determine whether to set a threshold and the threshold value based on your common scenarios). A score above 85 indicates a higher probability that the image contains a face, while a score below 85 indicates a lower probability that the image contains a face
items.description_zh: 目标是否为人脸及其对识别的影响分数，分数越高越有利于识别，取值范围(0,100]。如有多个人脸，则依次顺延。在识别时，推荐设置阈值大于等于85（您可以按实际应用场景判断设置阈值与否及相应阈值大小），大于85代表图片是人脸的概率越高，小于85代表图片不是人脸的概率越低
